collection.title: BMW i8 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW i8 2014 Onwards requires a 30" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: BMW i8 2014 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
